title: Super English!
sub: Belajar sambil bermain · Untuk siswa Kelas 4 SD
cando: Membaca jam dan menyebut waktu kegiatan.
Mengungkapkan perasaan dan memakai kata sifat berlawanan.
Menjelaskan cuaca serta letak benda dengan there is/are dan kata depan.

text.pron_note: Tulisan di dalam garis miring, misalnya apple /é-pel/, adalah cara mengucapkan kata itu. Bacalah seperti membaca tulisan bahasa Indonesia. Huruf é dibaca seperti “e” pada kata “bebek”, sedangkan e biasa dibaca seperti “e” pada kata “emas”. Tanda ini hanya bantuan — cara terbaik tetap mendengarkan guru, orang tua, lagu, atau video berbahasa Inggris. 🎧

goals: Membaca jam dalam bahasa Inggris: o'clock, half past, quarter past, quarter to.

sections.html:
• o'clock = tepat · past = lewat · to = kurang
  • quarter = seperempat jam = 15 menit · half = setengah jam = 30 menit
  • Awas! half past seven = 7.30, dalam bahasa Indonesia “setengah delapan”.
  • Cara mudah: 7.10 = seven ten atau ten past seven; 7.50 = seven fifty atau ten to eight.
sections.title: Ingat, ya!
Asking the time
head: English
Arti
rows: **What time do you** go to school?
Jam berapa kamu pergi ke sekolah?
I go to school **at** half past six.
Aku berangkat sekolah jam setengah tujuh.
sections.after: Pakai at sebelum jam: I wake up at five o'clock.

sections.title: Hurry up! — Cepat!
lines: Wake up, Tono! It's six o'clock.
Oh no! What time is the school bus?
Oh tidak! Jam berapa bus sekolahnya?
At half past six. Hurry up!
OK, Mom. I'll take a bath now! 🏃

sections.instr: What time is it? Tulis jamnya di bawah setiap jam!
sections.ans: 1. three o'clock · 2. half past ten · 3. quarter past four · 4. quarter to nine

sections.instr: Draw the hands! Gambar jarum jamnya.
sections.ans: Periksa gambar: 6.00 · 2.30 · 11.45 · 9.15 (jarum pendek = jam, jarum panjang = menit)

sections.html: Dalam satu hari ada 24 hours (jam), satu jam ada 60 minutes (menit), dan satu menit ada 60 seconds (detik). ⏱️

goals: Menyebut macam-macam pekerjaan dan tempat kerjanya.
Bertanya: What does he/she do? dan What do you want to be?

sections.title: What does he do?
head: Question
Answer
Arti
rows: Ayahmu bekerja sebagai apa? — Dia petani.
Di mana dia bekerja? — Di sawah.
Kamu ingin jadi apa? — Aku ingin jadi pilot.
sections.after: Pakai an untuk pekerjaan yang diawali huruf vokal: an artist, an engineer (insinyur).

sections.title: Who Am I? 🤔
paras: **1.** I work in a hospital. I help sick people. I wear a white coat. Who am I? — I am a ___ .
**2.** I work in the sea. I go out at night and catch fish. Who am I? — I am a ___ .
**3.** I wear a uniform. I help people and keep the city safe. Who am I? — I am a ___ .
**4.** I work in a restaurant kitchen. I cook delicious food. Who am I? — I am a ___ .

sections.instr: Tebak pekerjaan pada teka-teki “Who Am I?” di atas! Tulis jawabanmu di sini.
When I grow up… Gambar dirimu saat dewasa nanti!
caps: I want to be a/an ___ because ___ .

goals: Menjelaskan kegiatan di setiap tempat: We buy medicine at the pharmacy.

sections.title: Where do you go?
head: Question
Answer
rows: Where do you go when you are sick?
sections.after: go to the + tempat = pergi ke … · at the + tempat = di …

sections.title: A Trip to Town 🚌
paras: On Sunday, Rani and her father go to town. First, they go to the bank. Father takes some money.
Then, they go to the post office. Rani sends a letter to her grandmother in Surabaya. ✉️
After that, they go to the library. Rani borrows two books about animals. Finally, they eat meatballs at a restaurant near the park. Yummy! 🍜

sections.after: ☐ library☐ restaurant☐ bank☐ post office

sections.instr: Lengkapi dengan nama tempat yang tepat!
items: We buy vegetables and fish at the ___ .
I can see elephants at the ___ .
Near my house, there is a ___ .
Near my house, there is a ___ .
My favorite place is the ___ because ___ .

goals: Bertanya How are you? / Why are you sad?

sections.title: How do you feel?
head: English
Arti
rows: How are you? / How do you feel?
I am **happy** because it is my birthday. 🎂
Aku senang karena hari ini ulang tahunku.

sections.title: What's wrong? — Ada apa?
lines: Hi, Eko. Why are you sad?
Because I lost my pencil case. 😢
Don't worry. Let's look for it together!
Jangan khawatir. Ayo kita cari bersama!
Look! It's under the table! Thank you, Mira. Now I am happy! 😊
Lihat! Ada di bawah meja! Terima kasih, Mira. Sekarang aku senang!

sections.ans: 1. small · 2. cold · 3. slow · 4. dirty · 5. short · 6. sad

items: I didn't sleep last night. I am …|sleepy|surprised|happy
It's my birthday! I get a present. I am …|sad|angry|happy
I see a big snake. 🐍 I am …|scared|hungry|cool

goals: Bertanya dan menjawab How is the weather today?

sections.html: Indonesia hanya punya dua musim: dry season (kemarau) dan rainy season (hujan). Negara seperti Jepang dan Inggris punya empat musim: spring, summer, autumn, winter.
sections.title: Ingat, ya!
How is the weather?
head: Question
Answer
rows: Yes, it is. Bring your umbrella! ☂️
What do you wear when it is rainy?
I wear a raincoat and boots. 🥾
What do you do when it is sunny?
I play kites in the field. 🪁

sections.title: Weather Report 📺
paras: Good morning! Here is the weather report for today.
**Jakarta:** It is sunny and hot. The temperature is 33°C. Don't forget to drink a lot of water! 💧
**Bogor:** It is cloudy in the morning and rainy in the afternoon. Bring your umbrella! ☂️
**Malang:** It is windy and cool. Wear your jacket! 🧥 Have a nice day, everyone!

sections.instr: Baca laporan cuaca. True atau False?
items: In Bogor, it is rainy in the afternoon.
You need a jacket in Malang.

sections.instr: How is the weather? Tulis cuacanya!
Weather diary! Amati cuaca selama 5 hari, lalu tulis.
head: Day

sections.title: Prepositions — Kata depan tempat (Lihat kucingnya! 🐱)
Where is…? / There is… There are…
head: English
Arti
rows: Where is the ball? — It is **under** the bed. ⚽
Di mana bolanya? — Di bawah tempat tidur.
Where are my shoes? — They are **behind** the door. 👟
Di mana sepatuku? — Di belakang pintu.
**There is** a clock on the wall. 🕰️
**There are** three books on the table. 📚
Ada **tiga** buku di atas meja. (lebih dari satu)
sections.after: There is + satu benda · There are + banyak benda · Is there…? = Apakah ada…?

sections.title: My Study Room 📖
paras: This is my study room. There is a desk next to the window. On the desk, there is a lamp and a computer.
There are many books on the shelf. My bag is under the desk. There is a big clock on the wall, above the door.
My cat, Mochi, likes to sleep between the chair and the bookshelf. 🐈 It's so cute!

items: Where is the desk?|next to the window|behind the door|under the bed
What is on the desk?|a bag and a cat|a lamp and a computer|a clock
Where is the bag?|on the desk|under the desk|on the shelf
Where does Mochi sleep?|on the computer|between the chair and the bookshelf|in the bag
There ___ a pencil in my bag.
There ___ two cats under the table.
There ___ five students in the library.
There ___ an apple on the plate.
